Name: Ambient Nature Pack for Custom Music
Author: rahshu
Description:
This mod replaces all the main BGM tracks with ambiance from the natural world. Prepare to turn the music off, disconnect from all distractions, and embrace the ambiance of the world around us. May you enjoy this alternative experience.[code]﻿﻿[/code]

Listen to the Ambient Nature Pack [url=https://soundcloud.com/user-807337373/sets/stardew-valley-ambient-nature]here[/url]

﻿﻿﻿How To Install:
[list=1]
[*]Get [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]Custom Music[/url]﻿.
[*]Put Custom Music and the Ambient Nature Pack into your Mods folder.
[*]Run the game and enjoy.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Added tracks for title screen, load game screen, and character creation screen

Mods.RelativePath: [CM] Ambient Nature Pack\[CM] Ambient Nature Pack
